input: Gather requirements for an Acme Widget inventory tracker that lets warehouse staff scan widget barcodes, update stock counts, and generate low-stock alerts.
expected: The Acme Widget inventory tracker shall allow warehouse staff to scan widget barcodes to identify items, update stock counts in real time, and generate low-stock alerts when inventory falls below a configurable threshold. The system shall maintain an audit trail of all stock adjustments.
reference_actual: The Acme Widget inventory tracker shall allow warehouse staff to scan widget barcodes to identify items, update stock counts in real time, and generate low-stock alerts when inventory falls below a configurable threshold. The system shall maintain an audit trail of all stock adjustments.
